news_id.description: Stable article id (hash of normalised URL)

event_id.description: news_id + ticker (one row per article-ticker pair)

ticker.description: US-listed equity symbol affected by the article

company_name.description: Company name from Alpaca asset master

news_provider.description: API the canonical record came from: alpha_vantage | alpaca

news_providers_all.description: All APIs that returned this article

publisher.description: Normalised name of the actual news publisher

source.description: Publisher/source field exactly as returned by the API

author.description: Author(s) as returned by the API

alpha_vantage_id.description: Alpha Vantage record id(s) (derived from URL; ';'-separated)

ticker_detection_method.description: Evidence used to link the ticker

n_tickers_in_article.description: Number of tickers linked to the article

av_ticker_relevance_score.description: Alpha Vantage relevance of this ticker

volatility.description: PRE-news per-minute log-return volatility (prior sessions + same-day pre-news bars)

baseline_volume_per_min.description: PRE-news average volume per minute in prior sessions

baseline_return_count.description: Number of 1-minute returns in the volatility baseline

pre_news_close.description: Last traded 1-minute close strictly BEFORE the news minute

pre_news_return_15m.description: Return over the 15 minutes BEFORE the news (same session)

market_unavailable_reason.description: Why market data could not be aligned

market_session_date.description: Trading session the event was aligned to

market_timestamp_utc.description: Start time of the aligned T0 1-minute candle

alignment_lag_seconds.description: T0 candle start minus news time (negative = candle began before news)

open.description: T0 candle open (T0 candle overlaps/follows publication)

close.description: T0 candle close = reference price for post-news returns

return_1m.description: FUTURE return from T0 close to T0+1m (label generation only)

return_5m.description: FUTURE return from T0 close to T0+5m (label generation only)

return_15m.description: FUTURE return from T0 close to T0+15m (label generation only)

return_30m.description: FUTURE return from T0 close to T0+30m (label generation only)

return_60m.description: FUTURE return from T0 close to T0+60m (label generation only)

high_move_5m.description: Max high in (T0, T0+5m] relative to T0 close

low_move_5m.description: Min low in (T0, T0+5m] relative to T0 close

event_volume.description: Volume in the post-news volume window

expected_volume.description: Same clock-time volume in prior sessions (baseline for volume_ratio)

gap_return.description: Opening gap vs last pre-news close (overnight news only)

abnormal_return.description: z-score of the horizon that determined the label

label.description: spike | crash | neutral (market reaction following the news)

label_horizon_minutes.description: Horizon that determined the label (0 = opening gap)

direction_consistency.description: Share of horizons moving in the label direction

is_usable.description: True if the row has a label and passed all critical checks
